data_description.app_id: Leave blank and one will be generated. Only set this if you need to reuse an existing client identifier.

yaml_deprecated.title: Visonic Alarm YAML configuration is deprecated
yaml_deprecated.description:
Visonic Alarm is now set up from the user interface. Your existing YAML configuration has been imported, and all entity IDs were preserved.

Remove the `visonicalarm:` block from `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant to clear this message. Your credentials are now stored in the config entry, so they no longer need to live in `secrets.yaml` for this integration.

panel_offline.title: {panel} is not reporting to the Visonic cloud
panel_offline.description:
The alarm panel has stopped communicating with the monitoring server. The cloud keeps serving the **last known** arm state, so the alarm entity will look normal while being out of date — any automation that trusts it is now working from stale data.

Check the panel's broadband or GPRS connection. If the panel has an IP address but still cannot connect, confirm which server address it is configured to report to.
